svg.text: Test B: comparator board alone (as wired on 19 Nov)
C2BJ0VL steps IN+ through the threshold. C2BKNPC holds IN− at 1.20 V. The Siglent watches all four nodes.
Nothing else on the outputs: no CGR-201,
no resistors to instruments, no BNC cables.
If the supply is the E3630A: leave its −20 V terminal unconnected.
Test C: envelope detector into the comparator (planned)
VENV replaces the CGR-201 on IN+. Everything else as in Test B.
Nothing else on the outputs: no CGR-201,
no resistors to instruments, no BNC cables.
Detector: its own 5.00 V output (limit 60 mA) to its +5.0 V and GND tags; join its GND to the comparator GND.
